stem.en: Using the same two blocks (5 kg and 3 kg, g = 9.8 N/kg), find the tension in the string in newtons.

explanation.en: T = m₂(g + a) = 3 × (9.8 + 2.45) = 3 × 12.25 = 36.75 N. Checking with the other block: T = m₁(g − a) = 5 × (9.8 − 2.45) = 5 × 7.35 = 36.75 N — matches.

hints.en: You already found a in the last question. Substitute it into either block's own equation.
T = m₂(g + a), or equally T = m₁(g − a) — both give the same answer.
